title: Boruto
notes: Written by Ukyō Kodachi (vols 1–13) and Masashi Kishimoto (vols 14–20 / from November 2020), illustrated by Mikio Ikemoto.

in_universe.label: after Naruto (opens by retelling the Boruto film)
in_universe.note: Unlike the manga, which begins as a retelling of the Boruto film, the anime starts as a prequel set before Boruto and his friends become ninjas.

release.note: Wikipedia: It began serialisation in Shueisha's shōnen manga magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump on 9 May 2016. It ran in the magazine until 10 June 2019 and was then transferred to V Jump on 20 July of the same year. … In April 2023, the series concluded the first part of its story.

in_universe.label: after a time skip (teenage Boruto)
in_universe.note: it resumed in August of the same year with a second part titled Boruto: Two Blue Vortex in which a teenager Boruto continues protecting the village in solitude, now that he is seen as an enemy.

release.note: Wikipedia: In April 2023, it was announced that the manga would enter a hiatus; it resumed on 21 August of the same year, with a second part titled Boruto: Two Blue Vortex.
